controls.negative: the bare line fails both sides; lines with their bubbling removed or doubled act on no character

notes: The equivalence (★) <=> preserving Λ = R(G) is the repository's own reading of the residue rule (residue_cancellation_recognition.md); here it is checked as a biconditional on both truth values.

checks.name: the residue rule is equivalent to a well-defined action on the characters: criterion(x) <=> neumann_row(x) has no denominator, on 13 built lines (both true) and on the bare 't Hooft line U_2 + U_-2 (both false)
the bubbling corrections of every window line are O(q) as series (A2), and the pairing is δ + O(q) on all pairs
the two faces I_fg = Tr rho(f) g = Tr g rho^-1(f) agree on all pairs (the contour-shift cancellation the paper calls trickier)

the residue rule as a well-defined action on the G characters, u^m chi_e(v) = chi_e(q^(2m) v): every line acts on every character of its window, sum_a d_a(v) chi_e(q^(2a) v) a Laurent polynomial (pure SU(2): 5/5 lines, 4 characters; pure SU(3): 3/3 lines, 5 characters; pure Spin(5): 2/2 lines, 3 characters; SU(2)+1: 3/3 lines, 3 characters; SU(3)+1: 2/2 lines, 3 characters)

negative control: with the bubbling removed or doubled no line acts on the characters (pure SU(2): 0 of 10, pure SU(3): 0 of 6, pure Spin(5): 0 of 4, SU(2)+1: 0 of 6, SU(3)+1: 0 of 4 perturbed lines act)
